description: This file contains platform-specific functions and variables related to upgrading and checking images for the 'pistachio' board in the OpenWrt project. It includes functions for validating images, performing upgrades, and setting environment variables specific to the board.

methods.name: platform_check_image

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
